content.text: Team1 Builders Connect at Gokhale College of Engineering, Nashik 🚀
Team1 Builders Connect at Gokhale College of Engineering, Nashik
- a developer-focused gathering designed for students, aspiring builders, and technology enthusiasts who want to explore the world of
Web3, blockchain, and the Avalanche ecosystem
Whether you're completely new to Web3, curious about blockchain development, or already building projects, this session is your opportunity to
learn, build, connect, and explore new opportunities
Join fellow students and developers from
for an interactive evening featuring ecosystem insights, a hands-on introduction to Avalanche, discussions with the community, and networking with like-minded builders.
Come with curiosity. Leave with ideas, connections, and the inspiration to start building. ⚡
